response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS own FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), base AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, own, AVG(own) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mixbase, AVG(own) OVER () AS overall FROM units) SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_kept_ownership, AVG(own / mixbase) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline, AVG(own - overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM base WHERE own > overall

assumptions.assumption: Each transaction has exactly one ordertypedist, so a unit (transaction + order type mix) is effectively one transaction. Units whose snapshots all have a null instownpct have a null ownership. They are left out of the baselines and the overall average, and they are not kept.
